findings.claim: Job performance-budgets can finish its budget gate successfully when hotspot-degradation.json is absent.
findings.observation: The gate step exits 0 when reports/performance/hotspot-degradation.json does not exist.
findings.broken_invariant: REQ-TEST-005 requires the CI pytest command path to be an actual gate; a missing budget artifact must not be success.
findings.expected: Missing hotspot degradation report fails the blocking Tests lane.
findings.actual: At audit time the gate succeeded when the JSON was absent. Working tree now exits 1 when hotspot-observations.jsonl or hotspot-degradation.json is missing.
findings.impact: A green performance-budgets job, which tests-complete requires, can occur without a budget verdict if observations were not written.
findings.root_cause: performance-budgets treats a missing hotspot degradation report as success

evidence.observation: Gate step is if: always() and enters the checker only when the JSON file exists.
Report generation prints a skip message and continues when hotspot-observations.jsonl is absent.
_record_observation returns without creating a file when no output path is set; CI passes --perf-obs-out, but a run that never records still leaves the gate fail-open.

findings.acceptance: performance-budgets exits non-zero when hotspot-degradation.json is missing or summary.failed > 0.
validation: Inspect the gate step else-branch exits 1 before relying on pytest outcome alone.
findings.remediation: Fail the gate when hotspot-observations.jsonl or hotspot-degradation.json is missing. Do not raise budgets.
findings.automation: tests-complete already depends on performance-budgets; the inner shell must fail closed
findings.rollback: Revert the workflow step to the previous if-file-exists gate.
